name: com.dadaovalue/dadao-value
title: Dadao Value
description: Value-investing checkups for US-listed companies: five-step framework analysis. Education only.

tools.name: evaluate_company
tools.description: Run Dadao Value's five-step business-owner checkup on a US-listed company (incl. ADRs). Returns a dual-axis conclusion (business quality tier x price tier), a deterministic EPSxPE fair-value range, the first two analysis steps, three must-answer questions, and sourced key figures (FMP + SEC EDGAR). Education/framework only: never a recommendation, price prediction, or buy/sell instruction. Free tier; steps 3-5 are locked (full report is a paid human checkout). Results are cached per company for 24h.

ticker.description: US ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL) or company name (e.g. Apple).

tools.name: ask_framework
tools.description: Ask a value-investing framework question answered from the Dadao Value knowledge base (127 rules, 141 historical teaching cases): what makes a good business, moats, pricing power, valuation discipline, position discipline. Education only; stock picks and price predictions are declined.

question.description: The framework question, in Chinese or English (max 500 chars).
